# Failed-dispatch recovery clears the assignee

## Goal (user story)

As an operator, I want every dispatch failure path to release the claim's assignee, so a marker-write-failed or spawn-failed dispatch never strands an item as permanently unclaimable.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Failed dispatch (marker-write-failed / spawn-failed) clears assignee and leaves item re-selectable.
  _(Parent epic AC restated verbatim; this child is the covering work item.)_

- [ ] The marker-write-failed recovery path clears the assignee guarded by `--if-assignee <agent>` and leaves the item re-selectable.
- [ ] The spawn-failed recovery path clears the assignee guarded by `--if-assignee <agent>` and leaves the item re-selectable.
- [ ] After each failure mode, `wl show` shows `completed`/`in_review` with an empty assignee.
- [ ] Tests cover both failure modes and assert re-selectability by the audit tier.
- [ ] No dispatch failure mode can leave a non-empty assignee behind.

**Key Files:**

- `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.ts` (`rollbackClaimForFailure`, recovery/stranding paths)
- `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker*.test.ts`

## Deliverables

Recovery-path change plus tests.

# Ship release gate re-homed onto the assignee hold

## Cross-repo note

Implemented in the **SorraAgents** repo (`skill/ship/scripts/`); a SorraAgents (SA) work item is created there and linked from this epic.

## Goal (user story)

As a producer, I want the release gate to still stop me shipping unreviewed work after `needsProducerReview` is removed, so removing the flag never weakens release safety.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Ship release gate re-homed onto the assignee hold without weakening release safety (check-final-validation.js updated + tested).
  _(Parent epic AC restated verbatim; this child is the covering work item.)_

- [ ] `check-final-validation.js` blocks release while any in-scope item is producer-owned (assignee = producer sentinel from C6) without a passing audit ('Ready to close: Yes').
- [ ] `check-audit-gate.js` and `run-release.js` are updated consistently.
- [ ] No release-safety weakening: the scenarios that previously blocked on `needsProducerReview === true` still block (regression tests retained/ported).
- [ ] Tests cover: producer-owned unreviewed item blocks release; producer-owned reviewed item allows release; unassigned unreviewed item behaves as today.
- [ ] A SorraAgents work item exists and is linked as related work.

## Constraints

- Must not depend on the dropped `needsProducerReview` column.
- Must keep `closeWorkItemsAfterRelease` behaviour for ready-to-close items.

**Key Files:**

- `skill/ship/scripts/check-final-validation.js` (SorraAgents)
- `skill/ship/scripts/check-audit-gate.js`, `skill/ship/scripts/run-release.js`

## Deliverables

Gate changes, ported tests, linked SA work item.
